newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Dyckerhoff takes majority of Cement Hranice.
newsitem.headline: Dyckerhoff takes majority of Cement Hranice.

text.p: German cement maker Dyckerhoff AG has taken a majority stake in Czech Cement Hranice a.s., buying the shares previously held by Ciments Francais, a Dyckerhoff statement said on Friday.
Details of the purchase were not made public.
"The decision to enter the Czech cement production sector was motivated by our international strategy," Dyckerhoff Chairman Petr Rohde said in the statement.
"The new member of our family will have the prospect of not only our capital, but also our know-how and trading contacts," he added.
Cement Hranice, located in northern Moravia, has said it expects 1996 gross profits to rise by some 89 percent to 240.1 million crowns on revenues of 1.3 billion crowns.
